title: Component Instrumentation MicroSim
description: Manipulate a fake interactive textbook component (slider, Run Simulation button, quiz radio-group, Submit Quiz button) and watch xAPI statements stream into a live log on the right, building intuition for which UI events map to which verbs.
creator: xAPI for Intelligent Textbooks
subject: xAPI
instrumentation
verb vocabulary
ADL Verb Registry
chapter_title: Verb Vocabulary Design and the ADL Verb Registry

educational.audience: Developers and instructional designers learning to instrument interactive textbook components with xAPI

pedagogical.learningObjective: Manipulate a fake interactive textbook component (slider, button, quiz item) and observe the resulting xAPI statements appear in a side panel, building intuition for which verbs map to which UI events.
prerequisiteKnowledge: Basic familiarity with the xAPI statement triple (actor, verb, object)
Awareness that xAPI verbs are IRIs from the ADL Verb Registry
pedagogical.instructionalPattern: Manipulate-and-observe: learners trigger UI events and immediately see the resulting statements, including the deliberately silent case (radio selection) that teaches them when NOT to emit.
pedagogical.assessmentStrategy: Self-directed exploration; the live log provides immediate feedback for every interaction.
